subject: Slate shift: proposed MAP rephase & SLA exception request (Evergreen)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Slate shift: Evergreen MAP — proposed rephase

Connor / Marissa,

Quick summary from this morning's sync with Evergreen: their internal evaluation window slipped due to a security gating item (SOC2 evidence + audit-log detail) and a product-team demo that they pushed out by one week. That moves a few MAP milestones (integration POC, performance eval, legal sign-off).

I put together a lightweight rephase (attached) that keeps the evaluation cadence but moves the commercial close out by three weeks — net proposed close: 2027-01-31. Key asks for us:
- Ship the MAP v2 with an explicit sandbox cutover and test cases (attachment: MAP-v2.xlsx)
- Prep a one-pager for Laura/VP approval for a short-term SLA/credits exception if procurement asks for a runway
- Confirm we can provide the requested audit-log export and SOC2 pointers by EOD Monday

Can you two review the MAP and the one-pager draft before I send to Sarah/Tom? I want to keep this from becoming a full escalation but we should be prepared to offer a limited credit if procurement needs runway.

Thanks,
Avery

--
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@evergreen.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@evergreen.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Slate shift: Evergreen MAP — proposed rephase & next steps

Sarah / Tom,

Thanks for the time today. Attached is a proposed rephase of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP-v2) that aligns the remaining evaluation activities with the delays you mentioned. High level: we push the final close target to 2027-01-31 and split the performance eval into a gated run (week-long sandbox) + a full perf sweep.

Attachments: MAP-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone owners and dates).

Two asks from your side to keep things moving:
1) Confirm a procurement signal by Jan 14 (even a note that procurement is in review) — that lets us hold the reserved sandbox window.
2) Confirm the minimal SOC2/audit-log items Evergreen needs; Connor can deliver an export and a short evidence list by EOD Monday if we have the specifics.

If you prefer, we can run a short alignment call Monday morning.

Best,
Avery

--

Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@evergreen.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@evergreen.ai>
Cc: procurement@evergreen.ai
Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Slate shift: Evergreen MAP — proposed rephase & next steps

Avery,

Appreciate the proposed schedule. Two quick realities from our side:
- Our internal security review uncovered a gap around audit-log retention windows — we need explicit examples of logs and retention configuration.
- Procurement has put a temporary hold on new commitments while a Q4 spend review completes; we expect a decision by the end of next week but cannot commit before Jan 21.

Because of that, we are likely to need the close moved to the end of January (your Jan 31 target is reasonable) and a 2-week extension on the sandbox window. Also, can you provide any short-term commercial flexibility (credits or a trial extension) while procurement finalizes? That will make it easier for the procurement team to justify a narrowly scoped pilot.

Attached: security_questions.pdf — this is the list our InfoSec put together. Connor, can you point us to the log-export format and retention config?

Thanks,
Sarah Bates
Director, Platform Partnerships
Evergreen Analytics
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bates <sarah.bates@evergreen.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@evergreen.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Slate shift: Evergreen MAP — proposed rephase & next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and for sending the security list.

Quick answers:
- Audit logs: we can provide a downloadable export in JSON/CSV with timestamps, user-id, request-path, and response-code. Retention is configurable; default is 90 days, we can tier to 365 days for enterprise customers. I attached an example export format in-line (see sample).
- Sandbox: we can extend the sandbox window by two weeks and pre-provision a performance token bucket for the perf sweep.

Commercial runway: we can offer a limited 30-day trial extension + a one-time credit of up to 10% to cover the incremental tokens during an extended sandbox, subject to Commercial approval. If procurement will commit to a go/no-go decision by Jan 21, we can escalate for an ad-hoc credit approval.

Connor

Subject: Escalation: Evergreen MAP — SLA exception and credit approval

Team,

I reviewed the thread and Connor's suggested commercial runway. I'm authorizing a short-term exception path:
- Up to 10% one-time credit applied to the pilot period (not a permanent price change).
- 30-day sandbox extension to be granted immediately.
- Condition: procurement must provide an intent-to-decide note to our commercial team by 2027-01-21.

Please prepare a one-page executive summary (MAP-onepager.pdf) that explains the business risk, the ask, and the proposed conditional credit. I'll review and sign off; if procurement pushes beyond Jan 21 we will revisit but for now this is sufficient to keep the opportunity warm.

Laura
